batting.dismissal: st Q de Kock b A Mishra

balls.text: yorker length finally to finish off the innings, he's only able to hit it back to the bowler, but what an end to the Hyderabad innings.
and now over the off side, this is a good display of batting from Reddy, it was outside the off and he slices it over the in-field for a four
shot, out of here, length ball from Bravo and that's smacked, hoicked across the line over the mid-wicket region for a six to bring up only their second 150 this season
did I just see the Helicoper unleashed by Reddy, it was fuller on the off stump and he was looking to whip it across to the leg side, goes back to the bowler
pulled for a four! that's an extremely well-placed shot, it was hit between the long-on and the deep mid-wicket fielders and easily bisects them
full-toss and smashed back down the ground, Jadeja runs across from long-on and slides to stop it
and another one, four through the extra-cover region, another excellent over for the Sunrisers as he smashes it through the in-field

wow, that's a cheeky shot from a batsman who can thwack the ball hard, it was on a length on the off stump, slower one from Sharma but Dhawan was moving to the off stump and scoops it over fine-leg for a four
slogs it across the line and gets it to deep square-leg, they get an easy one before coming back for the second one, well run
was looking to drive it through the covers yet again but the lack of pace helps the bowler, gets a mistimed shot back to him
edged and runs through to the third-man fielder, Badrinath, it was on a length and he was looking to slash it away
slower one, but unlike the previous ones, it is a shorter one too and he's down the track and smacks it over deep mid-wicket for another six, good shot at a crucial time

and again, strikes it off the middle of the bat to bring up his first fifty this season...tell you what, it's his first game too. it was slower, fuller and driven over the extra-cover fielder for a four, better two overs for the Sunrisers
shot, he's come on and drilled it through the covers for a four, it was fuller and wider and he's able to get it away to the fence
slower one and he goes for another slog, gets only an inside edge through to the deep square-leg region for a single
slower one and he opens the face of the bat, looks to guide it over the fielder, gets only a single

gone, caught at backward point! it was outside the off stump but no pace there from Bravo, he was looking to drill it through the covers, the lack of pace defeats him and the drilled stroke goes to hand, Morris grabs it easily
round the stumps and hits it flat, straight to Vijay at long-off, that almost looked like it was running away from the fielder
fullish ball on the off stump, driven down the ground towards long-off, Raina from long-on had to run across to get close to it, well fielded
very full and just outside the off stump from round the stumps, yorker-length and despite a swinging bat, he misses
whoa, that's a six for Reddy now, short of length from Morris and he just goes for the pull, easily done and up and over the mid-wicket region for a six
and again, that was another big shot attempted, fuller yet again, opens his stance up and drills it back to the bowler, hits him and they are off for a single, would have hurt the bowler
what a hard shot! that was full from Morris and Sammy gives it the full swing of his bat, and over the bowler's head too, beats the long-off fielder
shot there, was slapped hard but straight to the fielder at deep covers, short of length too and had room to swing arms
quicker on a length, tries to cut it away but gets it as far as Badrinath in the covers, only a single
slower one, fuller and he had to check his stroke, only manages to tap it away to the off side
round the stumps to his West Indian captain, he was looking to come on the front foot but then pushes it to the off side for a single

gone, caught and bowled and danced! yep, short again from Bravo, he was looking to pepper him with those kind of deliveries, this time he goes for a pull, gets a top edge and it's easily caught by the bowler who then shows off his never-ending dance moves
balls.dismissal: X Thalaivan Sargunam — caught and bowled

balls.text: swing, an across line hoick, but the lack of pace from Bravo beats the outside edge. In fact, tell you what, he had played it way earlier
cut it through the covers this time and they come back for the second, short of length on the off stump, and gets it away
again a very quick ball outside the off stump, he wants to cut it away, misses the outside the edge this time, but a better over for the Sunrisers
shorter in length, flatter, quicker and it's worked away to wide long-on for a single and then he comes back for a quick second
short of length and tapped away to the leg side, the bowler runs across and fields
this is flatter now, fuller too and defended to the off side
whoa, whoa, whoa, that's as good as it gets on your debut, it was full enough and Sammy smacks it over the long-on for a six!
fuller on the off stump, driven to the short cover area
fuller from Bravo for a change, after all those short ones and driven to short cover, not for runs
short of good length and Sammy has his bottom hand off, gets some bat on it and it goes to the leg side, single for the batsman
short of length and Sammy's looking to hit away the first ball he faces in the IPL to the leg side, gets only a top edge and that's flown away over the keeper for a four
short of length but this has hit Dhawan, hard at that-area-that-I-cannot-talk-about. And he's down for the count, the physio is out and the TV commentator asks what can this physio do here.
slower one from Bravo, opens the face of the bat and pushes it to the off side, runs across for a single
shorter outside the off stump and the batsman is only able to tap it away to the off side, straight to the point fielder
there's a slip in place this time for all that opening of the bat, and this time he tries to stand up tall on his back foot and cut it, gets it to third-man alone for a single
goes down the pitch and wants to crash it away, gets the bottom of the bat and through to third-man for a single
continues bowling that short length and the batsman opens the face of the bat through to the fine third-man region for a single
shorter in length and taps it away through backward point for a single
short of length from round the stumps, aims to cramp him up, opens the face of the bat through to the third-man region for a single
short of length on his pads, he was moving back and across, pushes it to fine-leg for a single

up and over and smashed away for a four through extra-cover, Dhawan's turning it on there! it was very full and it was one of the variations from Ashwin, not that it was bothering the batsman too much and he just goes through with the shot
fuller and on the middle stump, pushes it to long-off for a single
bit of turn back into the bat, he was looking to defend it off the front foot, hits the pad and there's an appeal
fuller and on the middle stump, pats to the mid-on region
short of length and taps it through the off side for a single
reverses it for a four! it was from round the stumps and pushing towards his pads, Dhawan was able to reverse slap it away for a four
pulled away and rushes to the fine-leg fielder, through for a single, it was a poor delivery and it could well have gone all the way, misses that one Dhawan
half edge, half deliberate opening of the bat, runs through to third-man for a single
short of length and defended back to the bowler

short of length and on the off stump, pats it through the covers, gets one and is quickly away for the second too, that's good running between the wickets, but a direct hit from Bravo would have probably been out
fuller on the off stump and driven to the off side, straight to the fielder
short of length on the leg side, tapped away to the on-side for a single
fuller on the off stump, pushed into the covers and away for a quick single

and the pain ends, the misery ends. Mishra's holed out! he was looking to go down the track but it was not full enough to smash it, gets it off the bottom portion of the bat, is only able to scoop over to long-on where a catch and a dance awaits. It's Bravo doing both.
swept away this time to the leg side for a single
is he gone? he was looking to sweep by going down the leg side, Dhoni is unsighted but collects well and tries to whip off the bails but he's back by then
was trying to hit it over the top again, gets it off the middle but no power and it goes to long-off this time
leading edge and it almost carries to Badri at cover, he was running towards it but catches it on the bounce
goes down the wicket after that Time-Out but does not get to the pitch of the ball, is only able to pad it away for a single
full-toss and that's finally cut away through backward point for a couple of runs
and now he tries to go over the fine-leg, he was improvising by moving to the off side but misses, easily beaten
goes for a wild swing, wanted to go over mid-off, but is beaten, it was a short of length ball too
shorter in length and it's pulled away, straight to fine-leg for a single
short of length and it's flicked away to the leg side for a single this time
outside the off stump, not wide enough to be called one, Mishra was moving towards the leg side too and lets it go through to the keeper
beaten, bit of turn and that eludes the outside edge on its way to Dhoni
goes down the track, and wants to drill it through the covers, inside edge through that beats Dhoni
fuller, on the off stump, he was probably attempting the other one and he isn't able to get it away
stops in his action before delivering and Dhawan goes down and drives it to long-off for a single
it's slower from Ashwin this time and he easily tucks it away to the backward square-leg area for one
shorter from round the stumps, flicked away to the leg side for a single
another short one from the bowler and this is a far better shot, he pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a four
finally a four, not off the best of shots but the runs will help, it was a short of length ball and Mishra with only one from eight, gives room and swings hard, top-edge over the keeper for a four
bouncer and Mishra was looking to upper cut it, does not get any close to getting any bat on it, misses again
shorter in length and he was looking to flick it away by walking to the off side, hits his thigh pad and there's a frivolous lbw appeal
on a good length, and on the off stump, 136.1 km/hr, tapped to the off side but to the fielder
short of length outside the off stump, pushed into the covers and are off for a quickly taken single
tries to move in his crease and play it through the covers, the turn beats the inside edge of the bat, goes through to the keeper
goes down the pitch as he has so often done today, takes it on the full and drives it to long-on for a single
goes for a sweep this time, it's slower and it goes to the deep square-leg area for a run
steps out, drives to the covers but straight to the fielder
shorter in length, tries to flick it away but there's a leg-slip in place and it goes to him
round the stumps, on the off stump, not too much turn and opens the face of the bat through to backward point for a quick single
bouncer immediately and Mishra easily gets under it, even was looking for a wide there

edged and taken! yes, that's the number three gone! it was on the off stump and on a good length, he was looking to open the face of the bat, run it to the third-man region, gets an outside edge through to MSD, who takes it quite low down on his right
and again, skipping down the pitch with little respect for the bowler, very full and wider from Mohit, is able to dig it away to third-man, flies away as well
over the top and four! he's taking on the bowlers, continuing from where he had left off against Australia, fuller on the off stump and Dhawan has no hesitation in going over mid-off
bouncer this time, he was looking to come down again and Sharma bowls it short, it was too close to the batsman to pull away as well, which meant that he had to drop his arms down
crashed through backward point for a four! shot sir, that's again a shimmy down the wicket, the third time he's done that to Sharma, but this time there's width created and cracked it away
on the middle stump and White is able to just nudge it away through mid-wicket for a couple of runs, this looks like a good batting pitch so far, lot of bounce
shorter in length and on the off stump, pushed to mid-off and he's running with that shot, single for Dhawan
shorter in length yet again and easily pulled away, more like short-arm jab that rushes away through mid-wicket for a four
short of length and he was looking to run it down to third-man, goes straight to Jadeja at backward point and the batsman has no option but to retreat back to his crease
two in a row and there's no doubt about this one coming off the bat, short of length and pulled crisply through mid-wicket for another four
bouncer, pulled and for a four! that's given leg-byes which does not enthuse the batsman too much because it's come off the top edge of the bat! Am I seeing things?
fuller to the captain, outside the off and defended firmly into the covers
he was looking to run down the pitch yet again but this time the bowler pitches it further up, almost yorks him, Dhawan pushes into the covers and runs across for a run
pushed into the covers but to the fielder again, four dots to follow two good overs
again on the up and again straight to the fielder! this is good shot-making but not enough to find the gap through the covers, straight to the fielder
skips down the pitch to try and hit it over the top but the bowler sees that quickly, and drops it short, is only able to tap it away to the off side
hit on the up to one that's outside the off stump, good shot but straight to the fielder

gone, run-out, that's surely gone I think but we have a third-ump decision pending! Yep, that's out, Dhawan had pushed the ball into the covers and he wanted the single, the non-striker was a tad slow in responding to the call and Raina swoops down quickly and throws the stumps down at the striker's end, gone!
up and over and almost for a four, but that's well fielded by Mohit Sharma who dives to his left and fields it, restricts it to a couple
opens the face of the bat but is only able to dab it away to the point fielder
another one which isn't pitched in the batsman's half, easily turned away down to fine-leg for a single
on the off and driven on the up by Dhawan, gets another outside edge that runs to the third-man area for a single
and another wide down the leg-side, this was not as short, in fact it was full enough for Dhawan to attempt a flick, misses, wide called
shorter in length yet again and this time it's on the off stump, he is able to tape it away to the off side
short of length, but down the leg side, Dhawan was looking to go for the hook but does not get near it and it's a wide
outside the off and wants to hit it on the up, gets an outside edge and it runs through to the third-man fielder for a single
this time he affords slightly more width to the batsman who opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third-man for a single, there seemed to be a lot of bounce on that one
short of length, on the off stump and pushed into the point region by the new man

gone, caught, superb catch! my, my, the experiment with de Kock fails to work, it was very full and he went for a hard drive over mid-on, did not get the elevation he wanted and it flew to the right of Vijay who dives and plucks it out from thin air!
driven and that's gone for a four! it was fuller outside the off stump, he had the width to drive it through and he does just that, beats the cover fielder and it races to the fence
short of length from round the stumps and it sits up nicely for the batsman to hit, but is only able to pull it straight to mid-on, not for runs
hits straight and hits hard, down the ground for a four to finish it off in style, what a batsman, what a superb batsman, he's done it again.
no, no, no, what have you done there? that's wide down the leg side and there was no way the keeper could get close to it, gets some bat on it and it's gone through for a four.
bad ball from Reddy, slower one but very, very full, and Dhoni's smashed it over long-on for a long, long six
and another one, a very slow ball, Dhoni almost read it but it was so slow that he failed to change the stroke at the last second, misses
very wide outside the off stump, leaves it alone, was a slower one, back of the hand stump but called wide
outside the off stump and he was looking to give himself room, beaten, through to the keeper
gone, caught at point! that was smashed to the point region but it went straight to the fielder and is caught, Jadeja's got to walk. Checking for the no-ball but he's not transgressed there.
quicker bouncer and he was looking to lap it down to the fine-leg fence, there was a fielder inside the circle and could have easily got him a four, straight to the fielder

slower one and that has gone over the mid-wicket fielder for a six! half-century for Dhoni but what's with Steyn tonight, he is bowling length and despite the slowness of the pace he is able to crack it over the fielder for maximum!

up and over, that wasn't the most clever delivery from Steyn, the fielder was inside the circle on the off side and Steyn gave him room outside the off and he scoops it over the point region for a four
short of the length and that's tapped away to the backward square-leg for a couple of runs, well carved out that gap
short of length and beaten. it was a quicker one, almost surprised the batsman, 141.5 km/hr stuff and the pull shot goes nowhere, tell you what, it does not even hit the bat, through to the keeper
full, very full and outside the off stump, there is that drill down the ground but Darren Sammy is quite straight and it goes straight to him for a single
wants to pull away a short of length ball but does not get the timing on it, gets it through to long-on for a single
slower one from Ishant, bowling a lot of those tonight, wants to cut it away, misses the outside edge of the bat

pulled and caught! it was short of length, not too quick and Bravo, who has had a struggle in recent times tonight with the bat, goes for a pull, does not get the distance and it goes straight to Reddy for a simple catch at deep square-leg
wants to work it to the leg side, gets bit of an inside edge and they are able to get back for the second run, there was a bit of a misunderstanding between the two but easily come back
slower one from Steyn and that's pushed down the ground for a single by Bravo, his first run for nine balls
and another one, dot that is, on the off stump and that's only pushed to the off side, not for a single now
fuller from the bowler and Bravo has defended it to the off side, for another dot, the roles have clearly reversed between the two batsmen out there in the middle
slower from Steyn this time and it's pushed down to long-on for a single
and another short ball from Steyn and would you believe it, Dhoni has almost played a forehand smash over his head for a six over long-on, Novak Djokovicish that!
gone fora six! it was a length ball and Dhoni had no difficulty in spoiling the work from the previous over, pulled over the long-on field for a six!
would you believe it, we have a maiden in the 16th over of the innings, Karan Sharma has ended with figures of 0/8 in four overs!
and defended off the front foot now, Bravo's doing a Dhoni here, defending them all away
and again spins across the batsman, beats the outside edge, make that four dots in this over
fuller on the off stump, driven to the extra-cover fielder, not for runs
and turn again for the leggie, defended off the back foot

appeal for stumping and the third ump is called for. It was a good, quickish leggie, turns away from the batsman, Bravo was looking to defend at it, de Kock whips it off quickly but it looks like Bravo has his boot down just in time. The problem is that the boot comes up after the bails are out of the slot, which is allowed...not-out is the call
another slower one, it's been an over full of them and Bravo stands up tall, punches it through the covers for a single
short of length and defended off the back foot, back to the bowler
another slower one, taps it away to short third-man for a single
short of length, not too quick either, 121.7 km/hr and that's pulled away to the deep mid-wicket for a four, poor ball
now he goes exactly in that region, length ball and Dhoni hits it on the up and to long-off for a four!

very full from the bowler, he was trying to hit it over the in-field on the off side, there were two fielders inside the circle and had he chipped it over, would have gone all the way, instead it's straight to the extra-cover regionq
slower bouncer and it's called a no-ball, that was a very strange run-up to the crease from Ishant, looked a tad wayward, a Free-hit comes up now
full from Mishra and Dhoni pushes it to the deep square-leg for a single
fuller from the bowler, driven down to long-on for a single, bit of an inside edge to that googly
shorter from Mishra, easily tucked away to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple of runs
floated up, outside the off stump, defended to the off side

and this is gone, Raina's caught at long-on! it was fuller from Mishra and he tries to hit it over mid-wicket, what he does is to get a leading edge through to the long-off fielder where Sammy takes a simple catch
short of length from Mishra, tapped away to wide long-on for a single
tucked away to the leg side for a quick single, there was a bit of a misfield from Mishra but prevents the second
spanked, over the bowler's head and that's gone for a four. it was a fuller one from the bowler, and Dhoni gives it his all, smashes it away
outside the off stump and it's played down to the short third-man fielder, not for a runs
slower one on the off stump, Dhoni was looking to drill it away but slices it away, gets it to the right of the sweeper fielder, couple of runs
that's a poor ball from Sammy, it was okay for the bowler of Steyn's pace to get them short but not Sammy, easily pulled away to mid-wicket for a four
and another one that is chipped back to the bowler but he does not get his left hand to this one, is the pitch holding up here? goes away to long-on for a single
on the middle stump yet again and pushed to the leg side
ooh, what bounce, defended off the back foot, on the middle and it gave him some jitters there
is that another drop? he goes down the track and wants to chip it over the bowler, gets his hand to it, to his right, difficult chance
pushed it to the leg side and is off for a quick one
and this is full again, on the off stump, pushed to the covers
fuller, on the off stump, pushed back to the bowler
pulled away to the deep square-leg region for a single

dropped! Dhoni's dropped! whoa, how do you do that? Dhoni's looking quite rattled here, he was looking to pull it away again, gets a top-edge and goes to the fine-leg fielder, Mishra drops a sitter, just misjudges it
and again, this was quick too, 146.7 km/hr, was looking to pull it away but gets an inside edge through to the keeper, on the bounce, six balls without a run
goes for the pull, 148 km/hr, the ball does not come up to the bat, goes under his bat, through to the keeper
short of length, tucked away to the leg side for a single
wow, now that's a good shot, it was a very full one from the bowler and he has gone through with it, straight as they come, one bounce for a four
turns away from the bat, he was looking to play it off the back foot, but does not push it hard enough.
fuller and he was looking to play from the back foot, is only able to push it to the off side
another one played off the back foot, he was looking to cut it but the ball  does not come on to the bat
bowls from wide of the crease, quicker and Dhoni plays it back, defends it

gone, caught by the keeper! that's terribly unlucky there, he was looking to sweep it away, he missed it and it hits the pads, lobs up and then hits the back of the bat as he was looking to complete the shot, lobs up for the keeper to take a good catch
fuller and turning back into the batsman, swept well by Raina and to the fielder at deep square-leg for a single
bouncer that makes Raina hop, strikes him on his hip and they are away for a leg-bye
was looking to give himself room there, is only able to tap it away to the fielder on the off side, it was cramping him for room
continues to pepper him with the short stuff, continues to tuck it away to the leg-side, continues to run hard, continues to get a brace
short of length and tucked away to the leg side, that should have been an easy single, instead it's a very well-timed taken two runs!
short of length and wants to cut it through the point area, gets the fielder who misfields a tad and they are off for a single
bouncer, does not rise too high and Raina pulls it away to the fine-leg fielder for a single
fuller on the off stump, defended to the off side but not for runs
short of length from Mishra and punched back down to long-on for a single
gets his foot out and pushes it to the leg side, is immediately off for a couple of runs because the ball does not go all the way to the fielder there

goes down the track and is stumped! Vijay was not in his elements tonight and looked to go after Mishra, he was almost half way down the wicket but still did not get to the pitch of the ball, is beaten by the turn and is stumped by de Kock, easily done too.
fuller on the leg stump and easily tapped away to the leg side
reverse sweeps and that's gone for a four! it's a brilliant shot against the turn, against a bowler who has been doing well, bit of a top-edge there too
spinning back into the batsman, flicks it away to the deep square-leg region for a single
again on a length, he was playing off the back foot, pushed back to the bowler
shorter in length and spinning away, tapped it to the off side, straight to the point fielder
this is fuller from the bowler, driven down to long-off for a single
fullish again and tapped away to the right of the bowler, hits the non-striker
fuller on the off stump, driven to the short cover fielder
finally a defensive stroke from Huss, as he plays it back to the bowler
and again, Hussey's swept Mishra away for a four! it was fuller and he's deliberately gone over the backward square-leg region for a four, no fielder there!
was moving back to the leg side, shorter and spinning away, smashes it to the long-off region for a single
on his pads and he's off for a quick single again, does this well, slams and runs regularly
down the track and wow, that's been deposited over the long-on fence for a six! there was a fielder there and he could barely do a thing there, he seems to be in a hurry there
it's a flatter one, not the usual leggie, defended on the back foot to the mid-off region
shorter in length and he's able to pat it to square-leg and is away for an easy single
on a length and taps it to the off side, they are through for a quick single to the off side
on his pads and bit of a turn back into the batsman, glances it to the short fine-leg region for a single
this is very short and easily played away to the leg side for a single
shorter in length this time, a tad quicker and defended off the back foot
spin away from the batsman, he was looking to defend and the spin beats Vijay's bat
and again, this short yet again and that's pulled away through square-leg for a four, Hussey's in the form of his life and he's making it count big time!
short of length and that's pulled it away to the leg side for a couple of runs
down the leg side from a good length and de Kock does well to get to the ball, collects it well, he is also on the microphone, talking to the commentators
on his pads to cramp him from freeing his arms, taps it to the leg side for a single
short of length, a bit of bounce, defends it back to the bowler
short of length, wants to pull it away, gets it to deep mid-wicket for a single
goes down the track and caresses it over the covers, and it goes all the way for a six! he was using the feet and easily cracks the length ball over for the maximum
fuller this time and defended back to the bowler

that's a quick, shorter ball and he looked to be hurried into that stroke, was almost fending at it, but the fine-leg fielder is up inside the circle for some reason and the ball flies through to the fence
shorter in length from the bowler, he gets it off the middle of the bat, but to the cover fielder
this is shorter in length and Vijay was looking to flick it away, hits his pads, wanted a single but sent back
and now immediately taps it off the back foot, defended and off for a quick single
cut and is it dropped? it was hit really hard through the point region, there was width alright but good shot, and no it falls short of the point fielder but should have been fielded
wide outside the off stump, angling away from the left-hander, lets it go through to the keeper for a wide
length ball from Ishant, he opens the face to guide it towards the third-man for a single
and now four for Hussey too, it was short of length from Ishant and the fine-leg was up in the circle, is able to pull it away, gets the under-edge of the bat and it rushes to the fence
on a good length, he is able to flick it away through mid-wicket, mid-on and deep square-leg give chase and end up colliding and one them, probably Reddy takes a tumble
shorter immediately, and Vijay plays it out to point, was looking to get it down to third-man but goes to the fielder at point
up and over the bowler, it was marginally full yet again but this time it was in his swinging arc and does exactly that, four over Ishant
down the leg side, and Vijay was looking to flick it away over the leg side, walks too far across and misses, still it's a wide
fullish from Ishant, not the length that he usually bowls and Vijay gets his bat and pad out and defends it back to the bowler
